achievements.name: Tutorial Island
achievements.detail: Finish the lessons on Tutorial Island, Spin Dash included.

achievements.name: Banana Farm
achievements.detail: Clear all ten stages of Banana Farm so the next world opens.

achievements.name: Stage Mission
achievements.detail: Complete a stage mission by beating its time or collecting enough bananas.

achievements.name: Golden Banana
achievements.detail: Collect the golden banana tucked into a stage.

achievements.name: Story Complete
achievements.detail: Clear every stage in the ten story worlds, through Astrum.

achievements.name: EX World
achievements.detail: Clear all ten stages in one EX world.

achievements.name: Battle Win
achievements.detail: Win a match in Battle mode.

achievements.name: New Look
achievements.detail: Buy a style item from the Shop and equip it.

achievements.name: Time Attack
achievements.detail: Finish a Time Attack set and record a clear time.

achievements.name: No Miss
achievements.detail: Get past more than one stage in a single No Miss Challenge life.

achievements.name: Rolling Together
achievements.detail: Clear a story stage in a multiplayer Adventure session.

achievements.name: Ultimate EX
achievements.detail: Clear a stage in an Ultimate EX world.
